messages:
Ethan W: FYI EdgeWorks partner asked for an "integration rebate" on their onboarding invoices. They say a connector bug on their side caused duplicated test traffic during go-live and inflated usage in month 1. Asking for a partner rebate + a short-term volume tier for next quarter.
Clara B: How much are they asking for? Need invoice number and disputed amount before Deal Desk.
Ethan W: Invoice INV-2025-7880 total $74,900. EdgeWorks claims $11,250 attributable to duplicate test runs (they're asking 15% credit on their first-month bill) and want the first-quarter volume tier of 10% off on next $150k of usage as an onboarding incentive.
Sam Y: Do we have logs or a support ticket? Also confirm they're a registered reseller partner and whether this conflicts with partner discount stacking rules.
partner-bot: EdgeWorks partner profile: <https://partners.redwood.com/partner/EdgeWorks|EdgeWorks>  registered reseller tier-2. Opportunity P-3344 attached.
billing-bot: Support ticket SUP-9932 created, plus usage trace: duplicated requests from connector edge-sync v1.2.1 between 2025-03-02T02:00 and 2025-03-02T03:30 showing ~11.4M duplicate tokens.
Ethan W: Sales says the connector bug was introduced in their deploy, but they argue we should allow a partner concession for integration friction. They offered co-marketing, a customer reference, and a signed MOU to accelerate pipeline if we approve the rebate.
Clara B: Deal Desk checklist: 1) Confirmed partner status (yes) 2) Confirmed duplication origin (partner bug per SUP-9932 logs) 3) Materiality and commercial upside 4) Legal/precedent risk.
Sam Y: Since root cause is partner bug, I'm hesitant to give full 15% credit. But theres commercial value: co-marketing + reference + guaranteed pipeline ($220k ARR forecasted in P-3344). Suggest structured concession: one-time rebate of 10% on invoice = $7,490, plus a short-term volume rebate: 7% off next $150k in billed usage if EdgeWorks signs a 6-month partner integration MOU with defined milestones. Also require clawback if pipeline doesn't materialize in 9 months.
Clara B: Also ensure discount stacking rules: partner rebate must be net of reseller margin and recorded to GL PART-INT-01. Sales to attach MOU to SFDC opp P-3344 and log commitment.
legal-bot: Draft language: one-time concession explicitly non-precedent, conditional on signed MOU and co-marketing commitments. Add 9-month clawback with repayment terms.
Sam Y: Approver note: Approved conditional rebate of $7,490 (10% of INV-2025-7880) and conditional 7% volume rebate on next $150k usage. Conditions: (1) EdgeWorks signs partner integration MOU within 14 days, (2) Sales to attach MOU to SFDC opportunity P-3344, (3) Co-marketing deliverables (1 case study + 1 webinar) outlined in the MOU, (4) Finance to post GL PART-INT-01 and issue credit memo CM-2025-9900. Approver: Sam Y. :white_check_mark:
Ethan W: I'll notify EdgeWorks and attach the MOU template. Sales will capture the pipeline evidence and set milestone check-ins.
billing-bot: Created provisional credit memo CM-2025-9900 (status: pending). GL: PART-INT-01.
Clara B: Please record this in Deal Desk tracker and mark as "partner integration concession - conditional" for precedent review.
Ethan W: Notified partner, awaiting signed MOU. Closing loop when credit memo posts and MOU attached. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
